export declare const AGENT_PROMPT_LAYERS: readonly AgentPromptLayer[];

export interface AgentCompactionDeclaration {
    prompt_id: string;
    above_tokens: number;
}

export interface AgentManifest {
    directory_input_port?: string;
    text_sources?: AgentTextSourceDeclaration[];
    roles: AgentRoleDeclaration[];
    prompts: AgentPromptDeclaration[];
    compaction?: AgentCompactionDeclaration;
    skills?: AgentSkillDeclaration[];
    mcp?: boolean;
    characters?: {
        selection: "optional-exact-artifact";
        scope: "project-owner";
        role_ids: string[];
    };
    subagents?: AgentSubagentsDeclaration;
}

export interface AgentPromptDeclaration {
    prompt_id: string;
    version: number;
    layer?: AgentPromptLayer;
}

export type AgentPromptLayer = "base" | "role" | "project" | "task";

export interface AgentPromptText {
    prompt_id: string;
    version: number;
    body: string;
    layer?: AgentPromptLayer;
    user_revision?: number;
}

export interface AgentRoleDeclaration {
    role_id: string;
    version: number;
    name: string;
    execution?: AgentRoleExecution;
    workspace?: "required" | "none" | "business";
    prompts?: string[];
    host_tools?: string[];
    subagent_workspaces?: "required";
}

export type AgentRoleExecution = "read-only" | "text-edit" | "workspace-write" | "operate";

export interface AgentSkillDeclaration {
    skill_id: string;
    version: number;
    name: string;
    summary: string;
    tools: string[];
}

export interface AgentSkillDefinition extends AgentSkillDeclaration {
    body: string;
}

export interface AgentSubagentRoleDeclaration {
    host_tools?: string[];
    role_id: string;
    version: number;
    name: string;
    execution?: AgentRoleExecution;
    parent_role_ids?: string[];
}

export interface AgentSubagentsDeclaration {
    parent_role_ids: string[];
    roles: AgentSubagentRoleDeclaration[];
}

export interface AgentTextSourceDeclaration {
    input_port: string;
    output_port: string;
    artifact_type_id: string;
    schema_version: number;
}

export declare const BUSINESS_HOST_TOOLS: readonly ["ask-user", "update-todo", "find-tools", "context-remaining"];

export declare const METHOD_TOOLS: readonly ["find-capabilities", "read-capability", "change-capability", "suggest-action", "ask-user", "update-todo", "find-tools", "context-remaining"];

export declare function inspectAgentDeclaration(agent: AgentManifest | undefined, declaredInputPorts: readonly string[]): string[];

export declare function inspectMethodDeclarations(methods: unknown): string[];

export declare function orderPromptsByLayer<T extends {
    layer?: AgentPromptLayer;
}>(prompts: readonly T[]): T[];

export declare const platformPluginAgentContract: {
    readonly contractId: "io.molis.work.platform.plugin-agent.v1";
    readonly kind: "platform";
    readonly schemaVersion: 1;
    readonly maturity: "partial";
    readonly ssot: "docs/horizontal/agent-host.md";
};

export declare function promptLayerOf(prompt: {
    layer?: AgentPromptLayer;
}): AgentPromptLayer;
